Title: Persist User Data Between Sessions
Description: Save and reload core user data like playlists, liked songs, and settings when the app restarts.

Title: Add Recommended-Only Filter
Description: Let users view only recommended songs in the song list.

Title: Add Recommended Song to Playlist
Description: Allow adding a recommended song directly to a selected playlist.

Title: Build Basic Media Player
Description: Implement play/pause and skip controls for recommended songs.

Title: Improve Empty and Error States
Description: Show clear messages when no data is available or when loading fails.

Title: Recommend Smaller Artists from Listening History
Description: Suggest lesser-known artists based on the user's recently played songs and liked genres.

Title: Add Recent Plays Section
Description: Show a short list of recently played tracks so users can quickly replay songs.

Title: Add Like Button on Player
Description: Let users like the currently playing song directly from the media player.

Title: Add Remove Song from Playlist
Description: Allow users to remove songs from a playlist with one click.

Title: Add Playlist Rename Option
Description: Allow users to rename existing playlists from the playlist settings menu.

Title: Add Song Duration Display
Description: Show track length next to each song in lists and recommendations.

Title: Add Simple Volume Memory
Description: Remember the user's last volume setting between sessions.
